axis.description: By default, the index is into the flattened tensor, otherwise along the specified axis.

keepdims.description: If this is set to `True`, the axes which are reduced are left in the result as dimensions with size one. Defaults to `False`.

output.description: Tensor of indices. It has the same shape as `x`, with the dimension along `axis` removed.

constraints: indices dtype must be int32 or int64
